subject: HOT LOAD Dallas to Atlanta - dry van
body:
Need a 53' dry van ASAP. Dallas TX to Atlanta GA, 42,000 lbs of paper goods, about 780 miles.
Pickup tomorrow 10/6 between 8am and 12pm at ABC Distribution, delivery 10/8 by 5pm.
Paying $2,850 flat. Load #4471920. Reply with your MC# if you can cover it.

Mike - Summit Logistics
